versions.version: HpdfDocument.Pages follows the page tree (viewer) order; saving checks that every GSave has a GRestore; document dates honor DateTimeKind.Utc (new DateTimeOffset overloads); page labels always have an entry for the first page; SetXYZ, extended graphics state and page label values are validated as in the C library; generated font and image resource names start with "Haru". Fonts: text with non-ASCII characters is measured with the right glyph widths (standard 14 fonts by Unicode as in the C library, TrueType and Type1 fonts by their code page); Type1 fonts map all glyph names of the Adobe glyph list, so Central European and other non-Latin-1 glyphs are drawn and get their widths; the non-breaking space, the soft hyphen and other characters that share a glyph (Greek mu, Omega, Delta) are drawn and measured with that glyph; standard fonts draw the right glyphs with CP1251, CP1253, KOI8-R, ISO8859-14 and other encodings (the names of /Differences were shifted after a character without a glyph name) and have the Romanian T with comma below (ISO8859-16); TrueType text is measured with the widths written to /Widths; text shown with an embedded CID font (HpdfCIDFont) can be copied and searched with every code page, also CP932, CP936, CP949 and CP950 (the ToUnicode map is written from the glyphs shown when the document is saved; a glyph shared by two characters maps to the one that was shown), is measured with the glyphs it is drawn with whatever the code page, and the font's /W array holds only the glyphs in use; characters above U+FFFF (surrogate pairs, e.g. CJK Extension B) are drawn, measured, kept together when text is wrapped, and copied as one character when the font has them (cmap format 12; new overload HpdfCIDFont.GetGlyphId(Rune)). Predefined (not embedded) CJK fonts (HpdfCIDFontType0): character codes are mapped to CIDs with the CMap tables of the C library, so half-width and proportional characters are measured with their real widths; the /W array no longer gives CIDs 1-127 an invented width of 500 (some characters had two widths, and viewers spaced Latin text of the proportional fonts unevenly); MingLiU has the half-width Latin CIDs of its own character collection; the stub ToUnicode map is gone (a predefined CMap needs none); the encoder argument of HpdfCIDFontType0.Create may be omitted (new CIDEncoder.Create, GetCID and ReadCID). Embedded TrueType and CID fonts are stored as subsets with the outlines of the glyphs in use (a TrueType font: the glyphs of its code page; a CID font: the glyphs shown), so a document with CJK text no longer carries the whole 5-10 MB font file; the font name in the PDF gets a subset tag; the new property EmbedSubset of HpdfTrueTypeFont and HpdfCIDFont switches back to the whole font file. FontDataPool: the same font file can be loaded with several code pages (the second load returned the data of the first one); new overloads LoadFromSharedData(..., codePage) of HpdfTrueTypeFont and HpdfType1Font. Fonts by name: RegisterFont and GetFont understand the same encoding names (a font registered as "ISO8859-2" was not found by GetFont), in any letter case, including MacRomanEncoding, UTF-8 and the CJK CMap names; GetFont with the font name alone returns a registered font whatever its code page is. A font file without a PostScript name is named in the same way by every font kind (family and subfamily; FontDataPool no longer invents a random name). File structure: the entries of the cross-reference table are exactly 20 bytes long as the PDF format requires (they had one extra space, so strict readers such as MuPDF had to repair every file). Breaking: HpdfFont.GetCharWidth of a TrueType font returns 1000-unit glyph space as for the other fonts (was font units); a font whose embedding permissions (fsType) forbid embedding throws TtfCannotEmbeddingFont when it is loaded for embedding (a font that only forbids subsetting is embedded whole); HpdfCIDFontType0.Create without an encoder throws InvalidEncodingName for a CMap name the library has no encoder for; the default code page of FontDataPool.GetOrLoadTrueType is 1252 as everywhere else (was 437); GetFont and RegisterFont throw InvalidEncodingName for an unknown encoding name (it silently became WinAnsiEncoding).

System.Text.Encoding.CodePages dependency removed. Image transparency fixes (PNG alpha/color detection), validated color masks, reusable stencil masks, new HpdfImage.SetSoftMask. PDF version is raised automatically for transparency (1.4). Color masks work on gray images; a PNG is read from the current stream position. AcroForms: checkboxes, radio buttons and signature fields draw their own frame (colors from SetAppearanceCharacteristics), the appearance state always follows the field value, /SigFlags is set for signature fields; text and choice fields get appearance streams showing their values and the form gets default resources (/DR). New: HpdfPageText.TextRect, HpdfPage.Rotate, HpdfCatalog.ViewerPreferences and SetOpenAction, EoFillStroke/ClosePathEoFillStroke, SetFlat. Fixed: text measurement treated Unicode characters such as U+010A as line breaks; the text line position ignored the text matrix scale; a document could not be saved twice; non-ASCII text (field names, values and options, outline titles, document information) was written as UTF-8 and is now a PDF text string (UTF-16BE); with RC4 encryption only the first string of an object (e.g. of the document information) could be decrypted; non-ASCII link URIs are percent-encoded; Arc continues a path that is being built with a line (pie slices); outline /Count of closed nested items; TextRect honors horizontal scaling; setters such as SetBorderStyle, SetRgbColor, SetSlideShow, SetDestination can be called again; the compression mode applies to pages added before it was set; image masks and page labels raise the PDF version to 1.3; JPEG images are read from the current stream position. Validation as in the C library: GSave/GRestore nesting, invalid line cap/join/rendering mode, all-zero dash patterns, text without a font, equal arc angles, unsupported encryption modes, raw image bit depths, duplicate page resource names, widget colors, radio option names, choice values. Breaking: IElementAppearance has new members Caption and DrawFrame; IDrawable has the new member PathInProgress; Haru.Forms.HpdfTextAlignment is renamed to HpdfFieldAlignment (Haru.Types.HpdfTextAlignment is used by TextRect); HpdfString(string) writes a PDF text string instead of UTF-8; ShowText and related methods throw PageFontNotFound without a font; HpdfAcroForm has no public constructor (use GetOrCreateAcroForm); the duplicate extension method HpdfDocumentExtensions.LoadPngImageFromFile is removed; radio button groups accept only option widgets; HpdfSignature.SetValue/SetDefaultValue throw; SetEncryption requires an owner password that is not empty and differs from the user password (as in the C library) and accepts only Latin-1 passwords; the HpdfLinkAnnotation and HpdfTextAnnotation constructors are internal (use HpdfPage.CreateLinkAnnotation / CreateTextAnnotation, new overload with HpdfDestination); outline and link destinations need a view. Also: PDF/A sets the Print flag on annotations; PNG images load from forward-only streams.
Feature: Identity-H Unicode support in HpdfCIDFont. The skill for nuget-skills added.
Fully C# version of Haru PDF library.
